node_typescript.name: Next.js (App Router)
node_typescript.best_for: Modern full-stack web applications, marketing sites, SaaS platforms with SSR/SSG/Server Actions

node_typescript.name: Express.js
node_typescript.best_for: Lightweight REST APIs, legacy migration, quick prototypes

node_typescript.name: NestJS
node_typescript.best_for: Large enterprise backends, teams from Angular/Spring background, complex domain architectures

python.name: FastAPI
python.best_for: High-speed APIs, ML model serving, data pipelines

python.name: Django
python.best_for: Monolithic web apps, rapid admin dashboards, CMS
pros: Complete ORM, auth, and admin interface out of the box

go.name: Gin / Fiber / Standard net/http
go.best_for: Microservices, low-latency APIs, CPU/memory constrained systems

relational.name: PostgreSQL
relational.best_for: Default relational database for 95% of production applications

relational.name: SQLite / LibSQL (Turso)
relational.best_for: Local development, embedded tools, mobile apps, edge-replicated databases
cons: Single write lock (not for massive concurrent write loads)

nosql_and_cache.name: Redis
nosql_and_cache.best_for: Session storage, rate limiting, caching query results, pub/sub messaging
pros: Rich data structures (hashes, sets, sorted sets)

nosql_and_cache.name: MongoDB
nosql_and_cache.best_for: Hierarchical document storage, rapidly changing schemas, catalogs

orms_and_query_builders.name: Prisma
cons: Rust query engine overhead on cold starts

message_brokers.name: RabbitMQ
message_brokers.best_for: Complex routing, task worker queues, RPC patterns

message_brokers.name: Apache Kafka
message_brokers.best_for: High-throughput real-time stream processing, event sourcing, analytics pipelines
